items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: Sonny introduced me to five schools of jazz: Trane, Miles, Monk, Ornette

ctx.x: Sonny taught me about it. I studied, I did some improv study with Sonny. And Sonny introduced me to five schools of jazz: Trane, Miles, Monk, Ornette, and — Monk, Miles, Trane, Ornette and who’s the fifth one? Well those four.
